bible_quanes.question: What did God create on the first day?
bible_quanes.explanation: God separated light from darkness, calling the light Day and the darkness Night.

bible_quanes.question: On which day did God create human beings?
bible_quanes.explanation: God created humanity in His own image, male and female.

bible_quanes.question: What does the first verse of the Bible say God created in the beginning?
bible_quanes.explanation: The Bible opens by declaring God as the Creator of all things.

bible_quanes.question: What was hovering over the face of the waters at the start of creation?
bible_quanes.explanation: The earth was formless and empty, and the Spirit of God moved over the waters.

bible_quanes.question: What two great lights did God make on the fourth day?
bible_quanes.answer: The greater light to rule the day and the lesser light to rule the night
bible_quanes.explanation: The greater light rules the day and the lesser light the night; He made the stars also.

bible_quanes.question: How did God describe every thing He had made at the end of the sixth day?
bible_quanes.explanation: After creating humanity, God saw all He had made, and it was very good.

bible_quanes.question: What did God create on the second day to divide the waters?
bible_quanes.answer: The firmament, which God called Heaven
bible_quanes.explanation: The expanse divided the waters below from the waters above.

bible_quanes.question: What appeared on the third day besides dry land?
bible_quanes.answer: Grass, the herb yielding seed, and the fruit tree yielding fruit
bible_quanes.explanation: God gathered the waters into seas, let dry land appear, and caused the earth to bring forth plants.

bible_quanes.question: What did God create on the fifth day?
bible_quanes.answer: Great whales, every living creature that moveth, and every winged fowl
bible_quanes.explanation: God created the great sea creatures, every living thing in the waters, and every winged bird.

bible_quanes.question: What command did God give the first humans in Genesis 1:28?
bible_quanes.answer: Be fruitful, and multiply, and replenish the earth, and subdue it
bible_quanes.explanation: God blessed them and gave them dominion over the fish, birds and every living creature.

bible_quanes.question: In whose image did God create mankind?
bible_quanes.explanation: In the image of God He created them; male and female He created them.

bible_quanes.question: What did God give humans for food in Genesis 1?
bible_quanes.answer: Every herb bearing seed and every tree yielding seed
bible_quanes.explanation: Green plants were also given as food for the animals.

bible_quanes.question: From what did God form the man (Adam)?
bible_quanes.answer: From the dust of the ground
bible_quanes.explanation: God breathed into his nostrils the breath of life, and man became a living being.

bible_quanes.question: On which day did God rest from all His work?
bible_quanes.explanation: God blessed the seventh day and sanctified it because He rested from His work.

bible_quanes.question: What garden did God plant in the east?
bible_quanes.explanation: God placed the man He had formed in the garden eastward in Eden.

bible_quanes.question: Which two special trees were in the middle of the garden?
bible_quanes.answer: The tree of life and the tree of the knowledge of good and evil
bible_quanes.explanation: Every tree pleasant to the sight and good for food also grew there.

bible_quanes.question: From what did God make the woman?
bible_quanes.answer: From a rib taken from the man
bible_quanes.explanation: God caused a deep sleep to fall on Adam and made the woman from his rib.

bible_quanes.question: Into how many rivers did the river flowing out of Eden divide?
bible_quanes.explanation: They were the Pison, Gihon, Hiddekel (Hiddekel) and Euphrates.

bible_quanes.question: What work did God give Adam in the garden?
bible_quanes.answer: To dress it and to keep it
bible_quanes.explanation: God put the man in the garden to cultivate and guard it.

bible_quanes.question: What did God warn would happen if Adam ate from the tree of the knowledge of good and evil?
bible_quanes.explanation: God commanded Adam not to eat of it, for in the day he ate of it he would die.

bible_quanes.question: Who gave names to the animals?
bible_quanes.explanation: God brought every beast and bird to Adam to see what he would call them.

bible_quanes.question: What did God say was 'not good' in Genesis 2?
bible_quanes.answer: That the man should be alone
bible_quanes.explanation: God said He would make a helper comparable to him.

bible_quanes.question: According to Genesis 2:24, what happens when a man marries?
bible_quanes.answer: He shall leave his father and mother and cleave unto his wife, and they shall be one flesh
bible_quanes.explanation: Jesus later quotes this verse in His teaching on marriage (Matthew 19:5).

bible_quanes.question: Which creature tempted Eve in the garden?
bible_quanes.explanation: The serpent was more cunning than any beast of the field.

bible_quanes.question: To whom did Eve give the forbidden fruit after she ate it?
bible_quanes.explanation: She took of its fruit, ate, and gave it to her husband with her, and he ate.

bible_quanes.question: What did Adam and Eve sew together to cover themselves?
bible_quanes.explanation: Their eyes were opened, they knew they were naked, and they made coverings.

bible_quanes.question: What did God place east of Eden to guard the way to the tree of life?
bible_quanes.explanation: The sword turned every way to guard the tree of life.

bible_quanes.question: What did Adam and Eve do when they heard God walking in the garden?
bible_quanes.answer: They hid themselves amongst the trees of the garden
bible_quanes.explanation: They hid from the presence of the LORD God in the cool of the day.

bible_quanes.question: Whom did Adam blame when God asked if he had eaten from the tree?
bible_quanes.answer: The woman whom God gave to be with him
bible_quanes.explanation: Adam said the woman God gave to be with him gave him the fruit.

bible_quanes.question: To what did God say man would return?
bible_quanes.explanation: For dust you are, and to dust you shall return.

bible_quanes.question: What did God make to clothe Adam and Eve?
bible_quanes.explanation: God made garments of skin and clothed them.

bible_quanes.question: What did God say would happen between the serpent and the woman's seed?
bible_quanes.answer: It shall bruise thy head, and thou shalt bruise his heel
bible_quanes.explanation: This is often called the first gospel promise (the protoevangelium).

bible_quanes.question: Why did Adam name his wife Eve?
bible_quanes.answer: Because she was the mother of all living
bible_quanes.explanation: The name Eve is linked to the Hebrew word for 'living'.

bible_quanes.question: Who was the firstborn son of Adam and Eve?
bible_quanes.explanation: Eve said, "I have acquired a man from the LORD."

bible_quanes.question: What was Abel's occupation?
bible_quanes.explanation: Abel kept flocks while Cain tilled the ground.

bible_quanes.question: Who killed Abel?
bible_quanes.explanation: Cain rose up against Abel in the field and killed him.

bible_quanes.question: What son was born to Adam and Eve after Abel's death?
bible_quanes.explanation: Eve said God had appointed another seed in place of Abel.

bible_quanes.question: Whose offering did God respect, Cain's or Abel's?
bible_quanes.explanation: Abel brought the firstborn of his flock and their fat.

bible_quanes.question: What did Cain reply when God asked where Abel was?
bible_quanes.answer: "I do not know. Am I my brother's keeper?"
bible_quanes.explanation: Cain lied and denied responsibility for his brother.

bible_quanes.question: What did God put on Cain?
bible_quanes.answer: A mark, lest any finding him should kill him
bible_quanes.explanation: God promised sevenfold vengeance on anyone who killed Cain.

bible_quanes.question: What was the name of the city Cain built?
bible_quanes.answer: Enoch, after the name of his son
bible_quanes.explanation: Cain built a city and called it after his son Enoch.

bible_quanes.question: Who was the father of all who play the harp and flute?
bible_quanes.explanation: Jubal was a descendant of Cain, the son of Lamech and Adah.

bible_quanes.question: What did God warn Cain was lying at his door?
bible_quanes.explanation: Sin's desire was for Cain, but he was to rule over it.

bible_quanes.question: How old was Adam when he died?
bible_quanes.explanation: All the days that Adam lived were nine hundred and thirty years.

bible_quanes.question: Which man walked with God and 'was not, for God took him'?
bible_quanes.explanation: Enoch did not die in the ordinary way; God took him.

bible_quanes.question: Who lived the longest of anyone recorded in the Bible?
bible_quanes.explanation: Methuselah was the son of Enoch and the grandfather of Noah.

bible_quanes.question: Who was Noah's father?
bible_quanes.explanation: Lamech named him Noah, saying he would bring comfort.

bible_quanes.question: In whose likeness was Seth born?
bible_quanes.answer: In his own likeness, after his image
bible_quanes.explanation: Adam was 130 years old when he fathered Seth.

bible_quanes.question: Who was Enoch's son?
bible_quanes.explanation: Enoch fathered Methuselah at sixty-five years of age.

bible_quanes.question: Name Noah's three sons.
bible_quanes.explanation: Noah was 500 years old when he fathered them.

bible_quanes.question: How many years did Enoch live on earth?
bible_quanes.explanation: All the days of Enoch were three hundred and sixty-five years.

bible_quanes.question: What does Genesis 5 call itself in its first verse?
bible_quanes.answer: The book of the generations of Adam
bible_quanes.explanation: It traces the line from Adam through Seth to Noah.

bible_quanes.question: For how many years did Enoch walk with God after Methuselah was born?
bible_quanes.explanation: Enoch walked with God three hundred years and had sons and daughters.

bible_quanes.question: Who found grace in the eyes of the LORD?
bible_quanes.explanation: Noah found favour in a corrupt generation.

bible_quanes.question: What wood was Noah told to use to build the ark?
bible_quanes.explanation: He was also to cover it inside and out with pitch.

bible_quanes.question: How is Noah described in Genesis 6:9?
bible_quanes.answer: A just man and perfect in his generations, who walked with God
bible_quanes.explanation: Noah stood out from the violence of his time.

bible_quanes.question: How many of every kind of living creature was Noah to bring into the ark (in Genesis 6)?
bible_quanes.answer: Two, a male and a female
bible_quanes.explanation: They were brought in to keep them alive.

bible_quanes.question: What were the length, width and height of the ark?
bible_quanes.answer: The length three hundred cubits, the breadth fifty cubits, the height thirty cubits
bible_quanes.explanation: God gave Noah precise dimensions.

bible_quanes.question: What limit did God set on man's days in Genesis 6:3?
bible_quanes.explanation: God said His Spirit would not strive with man for ever.

bible_quanes.question: What did God see about the thoughts of man's heart?
bible_quanes.answer: Every imagination of the thoughts of his heart was only evil continually
bible_quanes.explanation: The wickedness of man was great on the earth.

bible_quanes.question: With whom did God establish His covenant in Genesis 6:18?
bible_quanes.explanation: Noah, his sons, his wife and his sons' wives would enter the ark.

bible_quanes.question: How many decks did the ark have?
bible_quanes.answer: Three: lower, second and third stories
bible_quanes.explanation: The ark also had a door in its side and a window.

bible_quanes.question: How did Noah respond to God's instructions?
bible_quanes.answer: He did according to all that God commanded him
bible_quanes.explanation: Noah's complete obedience is emphasized.

bible_quanes.question: How many days and nights did the flood rain fall?
bible_quanes.explanation: God caused rain upon the earth for forty days and forty nights during the flood.

bible_quanes.question: Whom did God tell to come into the ark?
bible_quanes.explanation: God saw Noah as righteous in that generation.

bible_quanes.question: How many of each clean animal did Noah take?
bible_quanes.explanation: Clean animals went in by sevens and unclean animals by twos.

bible_quanes.question: Who shut the door of the ark?
bible_quanes.explanation: The LORD shut Noah in.

bible_quanes.question: How old was Noah when the flood came?
bible_quanes.explanation: The flood of waters came on the earth in Noah's six hundredth year.

bible_quanes.question: What two sources of water were opened at the flood?
bible_quanes.answer: The fountains of the great deep and the windows of heaven
bible_quanes.explanation: This happened on the seventeenth day of the second month.

bible_quanes.question: Which sons of Noah entered the ark with him?
bible_quanes.explanation: Noah, his wife, his three sons and their three wives.

bible_quanes.question: How high did the waters rise above the mountains?
bible_quanes.explanation: The mountains were covered.

bible_quanes.question: Who survived the flood?
bible_quanes.answer: Noah only, and they that were with him in the ark
bible_quanes.explanation: Every living thing on the face of the ground was destroyed.

bible_quanes.question: How long did the waters prevail on the earth?
bible_quanes.explanation: The waters remained high for one hundred and fifty days.

bible_quanes.question: How many days' notice did God give before sending the rain?
bible_quanes.explanation: After seven days God would send rain for forty days and forty nights.

bible_quanes.question: Where did the ark come to rest?
bible_quanes.explanation: It rested in the seventh month, on the seventeenth day of the month.

bible_quanes.question: What bird did Noah send out first?
bible_quanes.explanation: It kept going to and fro until the waters dried up.

bible_quanes.question: What did the dove bring back in its beak?
bible_quanes.explanation: Noah knew the waters had receded from the earth.

bible_quanes.question: What did Noah build first after leaving the ark?
bible_quanes.explanation: He offered burnt offerings of every clean animal and bird.

bible_quanes.question: What did God make pass over the earth to make the waters subside?
bible_quanes.explanation: God remembered Noah and every living thing with him in the ark.

bible_quanes.question: What happened the third time Noah sent out the dove?
bible_quanes.explanation: This showed the land was dry enough to live on.

bible_quanes.question: What did God promise would not cease while the earth remains?
bible_quanes.answer: Seedtime and harvest, cold and heat, summer and winter, day and night
bible_quanes.explanation: God promised the stability of the seasons.

bible_quanes.question: How long did Noah wait between sending out the dove?
bible_quanes.explanation: He waited another seven days each time.

bible_quanes.question: What did God resolve after smelling Noah's offering?
bible_quanes.answer: Not again to curse the ground for man's sake, neither to smite every thing living
bible_quanes.explanation: God noted that the imagination of man's heart is evil from his youth.

bible_quanes.question: On what month and day was the earth dried?
bible_quanes.answer: The seven and twentieth day of the second month
bible_quanes.explanation: This was about a year after the flood began.

bible_quanes.question: What was the sign of God's covenant with Noah?
bible_quanes.answer: His bow set in the cloud
bible_quanes.explanation: God set the rainbow as a sign of the covenant between Him and all living creatures.

bible_quanes.question: What command did God repeat to Noah and his sons?
bible_quanes.answer: Be fruitful, and multiply, and replenish the earth
bible_quanes.explanation: God blessed Noah after the flood.

bible_quanes.question: What did God promise never to do again?
bible_quanes.answer: Destroy the earth with a flood
bible_quanes.explanation: This was His covenant with Noah and every living creature.

bible_quanes.question: What did Noah plant after the flood?
bible_quanes.explanation: Noah began to be a farmer.

bible_quanes.question: Who was the father of Canaan?
bible_quanes.explanation: Ham was one of Noah's three sons.

bible_quanes.question: What did God permit Noah to eat in addition to plants?
bible_quanes.explanation: They were not to eat flesh with its lifeblood still in it.

bible_quanes.question: Why is murder forbidden in Genesis 9:6?
bible_quanes.answer: For in the image of God made He man
bible_quanes.explanation: Whoever sheds man's blood, by man his blood shall be shed.

bible_quanes.question: What did Ham do when he saw his father drunk?
bible_quanes.answer: He told his two brethren without
bible_quanes.explanation: Ham saw his father's nakedness.

bible_quanes.question: How did Shem and Japheth cover Noah?
bible_quanes.answer: They laid a garment upon their shoulders and went backward, so they saw not their father's nakedness
bible_quanes.explanation: Their respect contrasted with Ham's behaviour.

bible_quanes.question: Whom did Noah curse after he awoke?
bible_quanes.explanation: He said Canaan would be a servant of servants to his brethren.

bible_quanes.question: How old was Noah when he died?
bible_quanes.explanation: He lived 350 years after the flood.

bible_quanes.question: Genesis 10 records the descendants of whom?
bible_quanes.answer: The sons of Noah: Shem, Ham and Japheth
bible_quanes.explanation: This chapter is often called the Table of Nations.

bible_quanes.question: Who began to be a mighty one on the earth?
bible_quanes.explanation: Nimrod was the son of Cush.

bible_quanes.question: What was Nimrod known as?
bible_quanes.answer: A mighty hunter before the LORD
bible_quanes.explanation: A saying arose: "Like Nimrod the mighty hunter before the LORD."

bible_quanes.question: After what event were the nations divided on the earth?
bible_quanes.explanation: These were the families of the sons of Noah.

bible_quanes.question: Name a city at the beginning of Nimrod's kingdom.
bible_quanes.explanation: Nimrod's kingdom began in the land of Shinar.

bible_quanes.question: What great city was built in Assyria according to Genesis 10?
bible_quanes.explanation: Rehoboth Ir, Calah and Resen were also built.

bible_quanes.question: Who were the sons of Ham?
bible_quanes.explanation: Mizraim is the Hebrew name for Egypt.

bible_quanes.question: Why was Peleg given his name?
bible_quanes.answer: For in his days was the earth divided
bible_quanes.explanation: The name Peleg means 'division'.

bible_quanes.question: Who is listed as the first son of Japheth?
bible_quanes.explanation: Japheth's sons were Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech and Tiras.

bible_quanes.question: Shem is called the father of all the children of whom?
bible_quanes.explanation: The name Eber is linked to the word 'Hebrew'.

bible_quanes.question: What tower did people attempt to build to reach heaven?
bible_quanes.explanation: The LORD confused their language and scattered them across the earth.

bible_quanes.question: How many languages did the whole earth have before Babel?
bible_quanes.explanation: All people spoke the same tongue.

bible_quanes.question: What did the people of Babel use instead of stone?
bible_quanes.answer: Brick for stone, and slime for morter
bible_quanes.explanation: They had brick for stone and tar for mortar.

bible_quanes.question: Who was Abram's father?
bible_quanes.explanation: Terah fathered Abram, Nahor and Haran.

bible_quanes.question: What was the name of Abram's wife?
bible_quanes.explanation: Nahor's wife was Milcah.

bible_quanes.question: Why did the people want to build a city and a tower?
bible_quanes.answer: To make them a name, lest they be scattered abroad
bible_quanes.explanation: Their pride opposed God's command to fill the earth.

bible_quanes.question: In which land did the people settle to build Babel?
bible_quanes.explanation: They found a plain there and dwelt there.

bible_quanes.question: What does Genesis 11:30 say about Sarai?
bible_quanes.answer: She was barren; she had no child
bible_quanes.explanation: This sets up the later promise of a son.

bible_quanes.question: From which city did Terah's family set out?
bible_quanes.explanation: They headed for Canaan but settled in Haran.

bible_quanes.question: Which son of Terah died before his father?
bible_quanes.explanation: He died in Ur of the Chaldeans; he was Lot's father.

bible_quanes.question: Where did Terah die?
bible_quanes.explanation: Terah died at 205 years of age.

bible_quanes.question: What did God tell Abram to leave?
bible_quanes.answer: His country, his kindred and his father's house
bible_quanes.explanation: God called him to a land He would shew him.

bible_quanes.question: How old was Abram when he departed from Haran?
bible_quanes.explanation: Lot went with him.

bible_quanes.question: Which nephew went with Abram?
bible_quanes.explanation: Lot was the son of Abram's brother Haran.

bible_quanes.question: Why did Abram go down to Egypt?
bible_quanes.answer: There was a famine in the land
bible_quanes.explanation: The famine in Canaan was severe.

bible_quanes.question: Name one thing God promised Abram in Genesis 12:2.
bible_quanes.answer: To make him a great nation, bless him and make his name great
bible_quanes.explanation: He would also be a blessing.

bible_quanes.question: Who would be blessed through Abram?
bible_quanes.answer: All the families of the earth
bible_quanes.explanation: God would bless those who blessed him and curse those who cursed him.

bible_quanes.question: What did Abram tell Sarai to say in Egypt?
bible_quanes.explanation: He feared the Egyptians would kill him because of her beauty.

bible_quanes.question: What did the LORD send on Pharaoh's house because of Sarai?
bible_quanes.explanation: Pharaoh then sent Abram away with his wife.

bible_quanes.question: Where in Canaan did Abram first stop, at the plain of Moreh?
bible_quanes.explanation: The Canaanites were then in the land.

bible_quanes.question: Between which two places did Abram pitch his tent and build an altar?
bible_quanes.answer: Bethel on the west and Hai on the east
bible_quanes.explanation: He called on the name of the LORD there.

bible_quanes.question: How is Abram described in Genesis 13:2?
bible_quanes.answer: Very rich in cattle, silver and gold
bible_quanes.explanation: He returned from Egypt a wealthy man.

bible_quanes.question: Who quarreled with one another in Genesis 13?
bible_quanes.answer: The herdmen of Abram's cattle and the herdmen of Lot's cattle
bible_quanes.explanation: The land could not support both of them.

bible_quanes.question: Which area did Lot choose?
bible_quanes.explanation: It was well watered, like the garden of the LORD.

bible_quanes.question: Near which city did Lot pitch his tent?
bible_quanes.explanation: The men of Sodom were exceedingly wicked.

bible_quanes.question: What did Abram say to Lot to avoid strife?
bible_quanes.answer: Let there be no strife between us, for we are brethren
bible_quanes.explanation: Abram took the initiative to make peace.

bible_quanes.question: Who did Abram let choose which way to go?
bible_quanes.explanation: Abram showed generosity toward his nephew.

bible_quanes.question: To what did God compare Abram's descendants in Genesis 13?
bible_quanes.explanation: If the dust could be counted, so could his descendants.

bible_quanes.question: Where did Abram then settle?
bible_quanes.answer: In the plain of Mamre, which is in Hebron
bible_quanes.explanation: He built an altar to the LORD there.

bible_quanes.question: How were the men of Sodom described?
bible_quanes.answer: Wicked and sinners before the LORD exceedingly
bible_quanes.explanation: This foreshadows Sodom's judgement.

bible_quanes.question: For how long did God promise the land to Abram and his descendants?
bible_quanes.explanation: God gave him all the land he could see.

bible_quanes.question: Who was taken captive when Sodom was attacked?
bible_quanes.explanation: Lot and his goods were carried off.

bible_quanes.question: Which king of Salem brought out bread and wine to Abram?
bible_quanes.explanation: He was priest of God Most High.

bible_quanes.question: What did Abram give Melchizedek?
bible_quanes.explanation: Abram honored God's priest.

bible_quanes.question: What was Abram called in Genesis 14:13?
bible_quanes.explanation: This is the first time the word 'Hebrew' appears in the Bible.

bible_quanes.question: How many trained servants did Abram take to rescue Lot?
bible_quanes.explanation: They were born in his own house.

bible_quanes.question: Who was the king of Elam who led the eastern kings?
bible_quanes.explanation: Four kings fought against five.

bible_quanes.question: What filled the Valley of Siddim, into which some kings fell?
bible_quanes.explanation: The kings of Sodom and Gomorrah fled there.

bible_quanes.question: Why did Abram refuse the king of Sodom's goods?
bible_quanes.answer: Lest the king of Sodom should say, I have made Abram rich
bible_quanes.explanation: He would take nothing, not even a thread or a sandal strap.

bible_quanes.question: By what title of God did Melchizedek bless Abram?
bible_quanes.answer: God Most High, Possessor of heaven and earth
bible_quanes.explanation: Melchizedek is later presented as a type of Christ (Hebrews 7).

bible_quanes.question: As far as which place did Abram pursue the enemy?
bible_quanes.answer: Hobah, on the left hand of Damascus
bible_quanes.explanation: He divided his forces and attacked by night.

bible_quanes.question: What did God say He was to Abram in a vision?
bible_quanes.answer: His shield and his exceeding great reward
bible_quanes.explanation: God told him, "Do not be afraid."

bible_quanes.question: What did God tell Abram to count?
bible_quanes.explanation: "So shall your descendants be."

bible_quanes.question: What was counted to Abram as righteousness?
bible_quanes.explanation: Paul quotes this verse in Romans 4:3.

bible_quanes.question: Who was Abram's heir before Isaac was born?
bible_quanes.explanation: Abram was still childless.

bible_quanes.question: Which animals did Abram bring for the covenant?
bible_quanes.answer: An heifer, a she goat and a ram of three years old, a turtledove and a young pigeon
bible_quanes.explanation: He cut the animals in two.

bible_quanes.question: What came down on the carcasses?
bible_quanes.explanation: Abram drove them away.

bible_quanes.question: How long did God say Abram's descendants would be afflicted in a foreign land?
bible_quanes.explanation: Afterwards they would come out with great possessions.

bible_quanes.question: What passed between the pieces of the sacrifice?
bible_quanes.answer: A smoking furnace and a burning lamp
bible_quanes.explanation: This represented God Himself making the covenant.

bible_quanes.question: What were the boundaries of the land promised in Genesis 15?
bible_quanes.answer: From the river of Egypt to the great river Euphrates
bible_quanes.explanation: God made a covenant with Abram that day.

bible_quanes.question: Why would Abram's descendants return only in the fourth generation?
bible_quanes.answer: For the iniquity of the Amorites is not yet full
bible_quanes.explanation: God's judgement on the land would wait.

bible_quanes.question: Who was Sarai's Egyptian maidservant?
bible_quanes.explanation: Sarai had borne Abram no children.

bible_quanes.question: What was the name of Hagar's son?
bible_quanes.explanation: Abram named the son Hagar bore.

bible_quanes.question: How old was Abram when Ishmael was born?
bible_quanes.explanation: Ishmael was his first son.

bible_quanes.question: Why did Hagar flee?
bible_quanes.explanation: She fled into the wilderness.

bible_quanes.question: Where did the Angel of the LORD find Hagar?
bible_quanes.answer: By a fountain of water in the wilderness, in the way to Shur
bible_quanes.explanation: He told her to return to her mistress.

bible_quanes.question: What is the meaning behind the name Ishmael?
bible_quanes.answer: The LORD had heard her affliction
bible_quanes.explanation: "The LORD has heard your affliction."

bible_quanes.question: What name did Hagar give to the LORD who spoke to her?
bible_quanes.explanation: She marvelled that she had seen Him who sees her.

bible_quanes.question: What was the well called?
bible_quanes.explanation: It lies between Kadesh and Bered.

bible_quanes.question: How was Ishmael described in the prophecy about him?
bible_quanes.answer: A wild man, his hand against every man and every man's hand against him
bible_quanes.explanation: He would dwell in the presence of all his brethren.

bible_quanes.question: How long had Abram lived in Canaan when Sarai gave him Hagar?
bible_quanes.explanation: Sarai gave Hagar to Abram to be his wife.

bible_quanes.question: What was Abram's name changed to?
bible_quanes.explanation: It means 'father of many nations'.

bible_quanes.question: What was Sarai's name changed to?
bible_quanes.explanation: God promised she would bear a son.

bible_quanes.question: What was the sign of the covenant in Genesis 17?
bible_quanes.answer: Every man child circumcised, a token of the covenant
bible_quanes.explanation: Every male was to be circumcised.

bible_quanes.question: What was Abraham told to name the promised son?
bible_quanes.explanation: God would establish His covenant with Isaac.

bible_quanes.question: How old was Abram when the LORD appeared and said, "I am the Almighty God"?
bible_quanes.explanation: God told him to walk before Him and be blameless.

bible_quanes.question: At what age were boys to be circumcised?
bible_quanes.explanation: This applied to those born in the house and those bought with money.

bible_quanes.question: How did Abraham react to the promise of a son?
bible_quanes.answer: He fell on his face and laughed
bible_quanes.explanation: He wondered how a man of 100 and a woman of 90 could have a child.

bible_quanes.question: How many princes would Ishmael father?
bible_quanes.explanation: God would make him a great nation too.

bible_quanes.question: How old was Ishmael when he was circumcised?
bible_quanes.explanation: Abraham and Ishmael were circumcised on the same day.

bible_quanes.question: When did God say Sarah would bear Isaac?
bible_quanes.answer: At this set time next year
bible_quanes.explanation: God would establish His covenant with Isaac.

bible_quanes.question: Where was Abraham sitting when the LORD appeared to him?
bible_quanes.answer: In the tent door in the plains of Mamre
bible_quanes.explanation: It was in the heat of the day.

bible_quanes.question: How many men appeared to Abraham?
bible_quanes.explanation: He ran to meet them and bowed to the ground.

bible_quanes.question: Who laughed within herself when told she would have a son?
bible_quanes.explanation: She and Abraham were old.

bible_quanes.question: What question did the LORD ask about His power?
bible_quanes.answer: Is any thing too hard for the LORD?
bible_quanes.explanation: He promised to return and Sarah would have a son.

bible_quanes.question: What did Abraham ask Sarah to make for the visitors?
bible_quanes.answer: Cakes from three measures of fine meal
bible_quanes.explanation: He also had a tender calf prepared.

bible_quanes.question: How did Sarah respond when asked why she laughed?
bible_quanes.answer: She denied, saying, "I laughed not"; for she was afraid
bible_quanes.explanation: The Lord replied, "No, but you did laugh!"

bible_quanes.question: Which cities' outcry was great before the LORD?
bible_quanes.explanation: Their sin was very grave.

bible_quanes.question: What was the lowest number of righteous people for which God agreed to spare Sodom?
bible_quanes.explanation: Abraham interceded, starting from fifty.

bible_quanes.question: Complete Abraham's question: "Shall not the Judge of all the earth...?"
bible_quanes.explanation: He appealed to God's justice.

bible_quanes.question: Why did God say He had chosen Abraham?
bible_quanes.answer: That he will command his children to keep the way of the LORD
bible_quanes.explanation: They were to do righteousness and justice.

bible_quanes.question: How many angels came to Sodom?
bible_quanes.explanation: Lot was sitting in the gate of Sodom.

bible_quanes.question: What happened to Lot's wife?
bible_quanes.answer: She became a pillar of salt
bible_quanes.explanation: She looked back from behind him.

bible_quanes.question: What did the LORD rain on Sodom and Gomorrah?
bible_quanes.explanation: It came from the LORD out of the heavens.

bible_quanes.question: What were Lot and his family told not to do as they fled?
bible_quanes.explanation: They were to escape to the mountains.

bible_quanes.question: What did the angels do to the men at Lot's door?
bible_quanes.explanation: They wearied themselves trying to find the door.

bible_quanes.question: How did Lot's sons-in-law respond to his warning?
bible_quanes.answer: He seemed as one that mocked
bible_quanes.explanation: They did not leave the city.

bible_quanes.question: To which small city did Lot flee?
bible_quanes.explanation: It was spared at Lot's request.

bible_quanes.question: Why did the angels take Lot and his family by the hand?
bible_quanes.answer: Because he lingered, and the LORD was merciful to him
bible_quanes.explanation: They brought him out of the city.

bible_quanes.question: Which people descended from the son of Lot's elder daughter?
bible_quanes.explanation: Her son was named Moab.

bible_quanes.question: Which people descended from the son of Lot's younger daughter?
bible_quanes.explanation: Her son was named Benammi.

bible_quanes.question: To which place did Abraham journey in Genesis 20?
bible_quanes.explanation: He dwelt between Kadesh and Shur.

bible_quanes.question: What did Abraham say about Sarah in Gerar?
bible_quanes.explanation: As a result, the king took Sarah.

bible_quanes.question: How did God warn the king who took Sarah?
bible_quanes.explanation: He was told he was as good as dead because of her.

bible_quanes.question: What did God call Abraham when speaking to the king?
bible_quanes.explanation: Abraham would pray for him and he would live.

bible_quanes.question: Who was the king of Gerar?
bible_quanes.explanation: He sent and took Sarah.

bible_quanes.question: How did Abraham justify calling Sarah his sister?
bible_quanes.answer: She is the daughter of his father, but not the daughter of his mother
bible_quanes.explanation: She had also become his wife.

bible_quanes.question: What did Abimelech give Abraham?
bible_quanes.answer: Sheep, oxen and servants, and he restored Sarah
bible_quanes.explanation: He also invited Abraham to dwell wherever he pleased.

bible_quanes.question: How much silver did Abimelech give Abraham?
bible_quanes.explanation: It was a vindication for Sarah.

bible_quanes.question: What had the LORD done to Abimelech's household?
bible_quanes.explanation: This was because of Sarah.

bible_quanes.question: Why did Abraham say he had lied about Sarah?
bible_quanes.answer: He thought there was no fear of God in that place
bible_quanes.explanation: He feared being killed for his wife.

bible_quanes.question: Whom did Sarah bear to Abraham in his old age?
bible_quanes.explanation: He was born at the set time God had spoken of.

bible_quanes.question: How old was Abraham when Isaac was born?
bible_quanes.explanation: God fulfilled His promise.

bible_quanes.question: What did Sarah say God had made her do?
bible_quanes.explanation: Everyone who heard would laugh with her.

bible_quanes.question: Where did Hagar and Ishmael wander?
bible_quanes.explanation: Abraham sent them away with bread and a skin of water.

bible_quanes.question: How old was Isaac when Abraham circumcised him?
bible_quanes.explanation: Just as God had commanded.

bible_quanes.question: What did Abraham do on the day Isaac was weaned?
bible_quanes.explanation: At the feast Ishmael was seen scoffing.

bible_quanes.question: What did God show Hagar when the water ran out?
bible_quanes.explanation: God opened her eyes, and she gave the boy a drink.

bible_quanes.question: What does the name Beersheba commemorate?
bible_quanes.answer: There they sware both of them
bible_quanes.explanation: Beersheba means 'well of the oath' (or 'well of seven').

bible_quanes.question: Where did Ishmael live, and where did his mother find him a wife?
bible_quanes.answer: In the wilderness of Paran; a wife out of the land of Egypt
bible_quanes.explanation: He grew up and became an archer.

bible_quanes.question: What did Abraham plant in Beersheba?
bible_quanes.explanation: He called on the name of the LORD, the Everlasting God.

bible_quanes.question: On which mountain was Abraham asked to sacrifice Isaac?
bible_quanes.explanation: God tested Abraham, but provided a ram as a substitute sacrifice.

bible_quanes.question: What did God do to Abraham in Genesis 22?
bible_quanes.explanation: God asked for Isaac as a burnt offering.

bible_quanes.question: What did Isaac ask his father on the way?
bible_quanes.answer: Where is the lamb for a burnt offering?
bible_quanes.explanation: He saw the fire and the wood.

bible_quanes.question: What was offered instead of Isaac?
bible_quanes.answer: A ram caught in a thicket by its horns
bible_quanes.explanation: Abraham offered it in place of his son.

bible_quanes.question: Who called to Abraham from heaven to stop him?
bible_quanes.explanation: He said, "Do not lay your hand on the lad."

bible_quanes.question: On which day did Abraham see the place from afar?
bible_quanes.explanation: He left the young men behind with the ass.

bible_quanes.question: Who carried the wood for the offering?
bible_quanes.explanation: Abraham carried the fire and the knife.

bible_quanes.question: What did Abraham name the place?
bible_quanes.explanation: It was said, "In the Mount of the LORD it shall be provided."

bible_quanes.question: How did Abraham answer Isaac's question about the lamb?
bible_quanes.answer: God will provide for Himself the lamb
bible_quanes.explanation: The two of them went on together.

bible_quanes.question: Why did God say all nations would be blessed in Abraham's seed?
bible_quanes.explanation: God swore by Himself.

bible_quanes.question: Whose daughter was Rebekah, according to Genesis 22?
bible_quanes.explanation: Bethuel was the son of Abraham's brother Nahor.

bible_quanes.question: How old was Sarah when she died?
bible_quanes.answer: An hundred and seven and twenty
bible_quanes.explanation: She is the only woman whose age at death is recorded in Scripture.

bible_quanes.question: Where did Sarah die?
bible_quanes.answer: Kirjatharba, that is Hebron, in Canaan
bible_quanes.explanation: Abraham came to mourn and weep for her.

bible_quanes.question: Where was Sarah buried?
bible_quanes.explanation: It was before Mamre, that is Hebron.

bible_quanes.question: How did Abraham describe himself to the sons of Heth?
bible_quanes.explanation: He asked them for a burial place.

bible_quanes.question: From whom did Abraham buy the cave?
bible_quanes.explanation: Ephron was a Hittite.

bible_quanes.question: What was the price of the land?
bible_quanes.explanation: Abraham weighed it out in front of witnesses.

bible_quanes.question: What did Ephron first offer to do?
bible_quanes.answer: To give him the field and the cave that is therein
bible_quanes.explanation: Abraham insisted on paying.

bible_quanes.question: How did the sons of Heth describe Abraham?
bible_quanes.explanation: They offered him the choice of their burial places.

bible_quanes.question: Besides the cave, what else did the purchase include?
bible_quanes.answer: The field and all the trees in it
bible_quanes.explanation: It was deeded to Abraham as his property.

bible_quanes.question: Who confirmed the property to Abraham as a burial place?
bible_quanes.explanation: It became the family tomb.

bible_quanes.question: Whom did Abraham send to find a wife for Isaac?
bible_quanes.answer: His eldest servant of his house
bible_quanes.explanation: The servant ruled over all that Abraham had.

bible_quanes.question: Who came out with a pitcher on her shoulder?
bible_quanes.explanation: She was the daughter of Bethuel.

bible_quanes.question: Who was Rebekah's brother?
bible_quanes.explanation: He ran out to meet the servant at the well.

bible_quanes.question: Where did Isaac bring Rebekah?
bible_quanes.explanation: He loved her and was comforted after his mother's death.

bible_quanes.question: What sign did the servant ask God for?
bible_quanes.answer: The damsel who shall say, Drink, and I will give thy camels drink also
bible_quanes.explanation: God answered before he had finished praying.

bible_quanes.question: How many camels did the servant take?
bible_quanes.explanation: He went to the city of Nahor.

bible_quanes.question: What did the servant give Rebekah after the camels drank?
bible_quanes.answer: A golden earring of half a shekel weight and two bracelets of ten shekels weight of gold
bible_quanes.explanation: They were gifts of gold.

bible_quanes.question: What did Rebekah answer when asked, "Wilt thou go with this man?"
bible_quanes.explanation: She went willingly.

bible_quanes.question: What was Isaac doing in the field when Rebekah arrived?
bible_quanes.answer: He went out to meditate in the field at the eventide
bible_quanes.explanation: He lifted his eyes and saw the camels coming.

bible_quanes.question: What did Abraham make his servant swear?
bible_quanes.answer: Not to take a wife for Isaac of the daughters of the Canaanites
bible_quanes.explanation: He was to go to Abraham's own country and family.

bible_quanes.question: Whom did Abraham marry after Sarah?
bible_quanes.explanation: She bore him six sons.

bible_quanes.question: Who buried Abraham?
bible_quanes.explanation: They buried him in the cave of Machpelah.

bible_quanes.question: Which twin came out first, red and hairy?
bible_quanes.explanation: He was named Esau.

bible_quanes.question: Which twin came out holding his brother's heel?
bible_quanes.explanation: That is why he was named Jacob.

bible_quanes.question: How old was Abraham when he died?
bible_quanes.explanation: He died in a good old age.

bible_quanes.question: What did Isaac do because Rebekah was barren?
bible_quanes.answer: He intreated the LORD for his wife
bible_quanes.explanation: The LORD granted his plea.

bible_quanes.question: What did God tell Rebekah about her twins?
bible_quanes.answer: Two nations are in her womb, and the elder shall serve the younger
bible_quanes.explanation: The children struggled within her.

bible_quanes.question: For what did Esau sell his birthright?
bible_quanes.explanation: Esau despised his birthright.

bible_quanes.question: What other name was Esau called because of the red stew?
bible_quanes.explanation: Edom means 'red'.

bible_quanes.question: Which son did Isaac love, and which did Rebekah love?
bible_quanes.answer: Isaac loved Esau; Rebekah loved Jacob
bible_quanes.explanation: Isaac loved the game Esau hunted.

bible_quanes.question: Why did Isaac go to Gerar?
bible_quanes.answer: There was a famine in the land
bible_quanes.explanation: It was a famine like the one in Abraham's day.

bible_quanes.question: What did Isaac say about Rebekah in Gerar?
bible_quanes.explanation: He feared the men of the place would kill him.

bible_quanes.question: How much did Isaac reap in the year he sowed in Gerar?
bible_quanes.explanation: The LORD blessed him.

bible_quanes.question: What did Isaac name the well where he made an oath with Abimelech?
bible_quanes.explanation: The city is called Beersheba to this day.

bible_quanes.question: Where did God tell Isaac not to go?
bible_quanes.explanation: He was to stay in the land God would show him.

bible_quanes.question: How did Abimelech discover that Rebekah was Isaac's wife?
bible_quanes.answer: He looked out at a window and saw Isaac sporting with Rebekah
bible_quanes.explanation: He rebuked Isaac for the deception.

bible_quanes.question: What had the Philistines done to Abraham's wells?
bible_quanes.answer: Stopped them up and filled them with earth
bible_quanes.explanation: They did it out of envy.

bible_quanes.question: Why did Isaac name a well Rehoboth?
bible_quanes.answer: For they strove not; the LORD hath made room for us
bible_quanes.explanation: Rehoboth means 'broad places' or 'room'.

bible_quanes.question: What were the two wells called where the herdsmen of Gerar quarreled?
bible_quanes.explanation: Isaac moved on until there was peace.

bible_quanes.question: Whom did Esau marry at forty, to his parents' grief?
bible_quanes.answer: Judith the daughter of Beeri the Hittite and Bashemath the daughter of Elon the Hittite
bible_quanes.explanation: They were a grief of mind to Isaac and Rebekah.

bible_quanes.question: Why couldn't Isaac see?
bible_quanes.answer: He was old and his eyes were dim
bible_quanes.explanation: He called for Esau.

bible_quanes.question: What did Isaac ask Esau to make him?
bible_quanes.answer: Venison, and savoury meat, such as I love
bible_quanes.explanation: So that he could bless him.

bible_quanes.question: What did Rebekah put on Jacob's hands and neck?
bible_quanes.answer: The skins of the kids of the goats
bible_quanes.explanation: To make him feel like hairy Esau.

bible_quanes.question: What did Isaac smell on Jacob?
bible_quanes.answer: The smell of his raiment, as the smell of a field which the LORD hath blessed
bible_quanes.explanation: Then he blessed him.

bible_quanes.question: What did Isaac say about the voice and the hands?
bible_quanes.answer: The voice is Jacob's voice, but the hands are the hands of Esau
bible_quanes.explanation: Isaac did not recognize him.

bible_quanes.question: What did Esau say Jacob had taken from him twice?
bible_quanes.explanation: Esau linked Jacob's name to supplanting.

bible_quanes.question: What did Esau plan to do after Isaac's death?
bible_quanes.explanation: Esau hated Jacob because of the blessing.

bible_quanes.question: Where did Rebekah send Jacob?
bible_quanes.answer: To her brother Laban in Haran
bible_quanes.explanation: Until Esau's anger turned away.

bible_quanes.question: What did Isaac say Esau would eventually do?
bible_quanes.answer: Break his yoke from off his neck
bible_quanes.explanation: He would live by the sword.

bible_quanes.question: What reason did Rebekah give Isaac for sending Jacob away?
bible_quanes.answer: She was weary of her life because of the daughters of Heth
bible_quanes.explanation: She did not mention Esau's threat.

bible_quanes.question: What did Jacob dream of at Bethel?
bible_quanes.answer: A ladder set up on the earth, the top of it reached to heaven, and angels ascending and descending
bible_quanes.explanation: The Lord stood above it.

bible_quanes.question: What did Jacob use as a pillow?
bible_quanes.explanation: He lay down there to sleep.

bible_quanes.question: What did Jacob name the place?
bible_quanes.explanation: The city was formerly called Luz.

bible_quanes.question: What did Jacob vow to give God?
bible_quanes.answer: The tenth of all that God shall give him
bible_quanes.explanation: This was if God kept him on his journey.

bible_quanes.question: Where did Isaac send Jacob to find a wife?
bible_quanes.answer: Padanaram, to the house of Bethuel
bible_quanes.explanation: He was to marry a daughter of Laban.

bible_quanes.question: Whom did Esau marry to try to please his father?
bible_quanes.explanation: He realized the Canaanite women displeased Isaac.

bible_quanes.question: What did God promise Jacob at Bethel?
bible_quanes.answer: "I am with thee, and will keep thee... and will bring thee again into this land"
bible_quanes.explanation: God would not leave him.

bible_quanes.question: What did Jacob do with the stone he slept on?
bible_quanes.answer: Set it up as a pillar and poured oil on it
bible_quanes.explanation: He consecrated it to God.

bible_quanes.question: What did Jacob call Bethel?
bible_quanes.answer: The house of God and the gate of heaven
bible_quanes.explanation: He was afraid and awed.

bible_quanes.question: To what were Jacob's descendants compared in his dream?
bible_quanes.explanation: They would spread west, east, north and south.

bible_quanes.question: What did Jacob do when he saw Rachel?
bible_quanes.answer: He rolled the stone from the well's mouth and watered her flock
bible_quanes.explanation: Then he kissed her and wept.

bible_quanes.question: How many years did Jacob agree to serve for Rachel?
bible_quanes.explanation: He loved Rachel.

bible_quanes.question: Whom did Jacob find he had married?
bible_quanes.explanation: Laban had deceived him.

bible_quanes.question: What was Leah's fourth son named?
bible_quanes.explanation: She said, "Now I will praise the LORD."

bible_quanes.question: How were Leah and Rachel described?
bible_quanes.answer: Leah was tender eyed; Rachel was beautiful and well favoured
bible_quanes.explanation: Jacob loved Rachel.

bible_quanes.question: How did the seven years seem to Jacob?
bible_quanes.answer: But a few days, for the love he had to her
bible_quanes.explanation: Because of his love for Rachel.

bible_quanes.question: What custom did Laban give for his deception?
bible_quanes.answer: It must not be so done, to give the younger before the firstborn
bible_quanes.explanation: He then offered Rachel for another seven years.

bible_quanes.question: What was Leah's firstborn son named?
bible_quanes.explanation: She said, "The LORD has surely looked on my affliction."

bible_quanes.question: Who was Leah's maid?
bible_quanes.explanation: Laban gave her to Leah.

bible_quanes.question: Who was Rachel's maid?
bible_quanes.explanation: Laban gave her to Rachel.

bible_quanes.question: Who envied her sister for bearing children?
bible_quanes.explanation: She said to Jacob, "Give me children, or else I die!"

bible_quanes.question: What was Rachel's first son named?
bible_quanes.explanation: She said, "The LORD shall add to me another son."

bible_quanes.question: What plants did Reuben find in the field?
bible_quanes.explanation: Rachel asked Leah for them.

bible_quanes.question: What daughter did Leah bear?
bible_quanes.explanation: She was born after Leah's six sons.

bible_quanes.question: What was the first son Bilhah bore for Rachel?
bible_quanes.explanation: Rachel said, "God has judged my case."

bible_quanes.question: What was Zilpah's first son?
bible_quanes.explanation: Leah said, "A troop comes!"

bible_quanes.question: Who was Leah's fifth son?
bible_quanes.explanation: She said God had given her wages.

bible_quanes.question: Who was Leah's sixth son?
bible_quanes.explanation: She said God had endowed her with a good endowment.

bible_quanes.question: What wages did Jacob ask Laban for?
bible_quanes.answer: All the speckled and spotted cattle, and all the brown cattle
bible_quanes.explanation: Jacob's flock grew greatly.

bible_quanes.question: What did Jacob place in the watering troughs?
bible_quanes.answer: Rods of green poplar, hazel and chesnut tree, pilled white strakes in them
bible_quanes.explanation: The flocks bore streaked, speckled and spotted young.

bible_quanes.question: What did God tell Jacob in Genesis 31:3?
bible_quanes.answer: Return to the land of your fathers
bible_quanes.explanation: God promised to be with him.

bible_quanes.question: What did Rachel steal from her father?
bible_quanes.answer: The images that were her father's
bible_quanes.explanation: Laban later searched for them.

bible_quanes.question: Where did Rachel hide the idols?
bible_quanes.answer: In the camel's furniture, and she sat upon them
bible_quanes.explanation: Laban did not find them.

bible_quanes.question: How did God warn Laban?
bible_quanes.explanation: He was told to speak neither good nor bad to Jacob.

bible_quanes.question: How many times did Jacob say Laban had changed his wages?
bible_quanes.explanation: But God did not allow Laban to harm him.

bible_quanes.question: How long did Jacob serve Laban altogether?
bible_quanes.explanation: Fourteen for his daughters and six for his flock.

bible_quanes.question: What did Jacob call the heap of stones that witnessed his covenant with Laban?
bible_quanes.explanation: Laban called it Jegarsahadutha; both mean 'heap of witness'.

bible_quanes.question: What did Laban ask the LORD to do at Mizpah?
bible_quanes.answer: The LORD watch between me and thee, when we are absent one from another
bible_quanes.explanation: It marked their covenant.

bible_quanes.question: By what name did Jacob refer to God in Genesis 31:42?
bible_quanes.explanation: He also called Him the God of Abraham.

bible_quanes.question: Toward which mountains did Jacob flee?
bible_quanes.explanation: He crossed the river.

bible_quanes.question: What was Jacob's name changed to?
bible_quanes.explanation: After wrestling with the angel, Jacob's name was changed to Israel.

bible_quanes.question: Who met Jacob on his way?
bible_quanes.explanation: He called the place Mahanaim.

bible_quanes.question: How many men were coming with Esau?
bible_quanes.explanation: Jacob was greatly afraid.

bible_quanes.question: With whom did Jacob wrestle until daybreak?
bible_quanes.explanation: They wrestled through the night.

bible_quanes.question: What did Jacob name the place where he wrestled?
bible_quanes.explanation: "For I have seen God face to face."

bible_quanes.question: What did Jacob do with his people out of fear?
bible_quanes.explanation: If one was attacked, the other could escape.

bible_quanes.question: What did Jacob send ahead to Esau?
bible_quanes.answer: A present for Esau his brother
bible_quanes.explanation: He hoped to appease him.

bible_quanes.question: What happened to Jacob's hip?
bible_quanes.answer: The hollow of his thigh was out of joint
bible_quanes.explanation: The Man touched the socket of his hip.

bible_quanes.question: What did Jacob say when the Man asked to be let go?
bible_quanes.answer: "I will not let thee go, except thou bless me"
bible_quanes.explanation: He persisted for a blessing.

bible_quanes.question: What did Jacob say he had when he first crossed the Jordan?
bible_quanes.explanation: Now he had become two companies.

bible_quanes.question: What do the children of Israel not eat because of Jacob's injury?
bible_quanes.answer: The sinew which shrank, upon the hollow of the thigh
bible_quanes.explanation: It commemorates Jacob's wrestling.

bible_quanes.question: How did Esau greet Jacob?
bible_quanes.answer: He ran to meet him, embraced him, fell on his neck and kissed him, and they wept
bible_quanes.explanation: The brothers were reconciled.

bible_quanes.question: How many times did Jacob bow to the ground as he approached Esau?
bible_quanes.explanation: It was a sign of humility.

bible_quanes.question: Did Esau accept Jacob's gift?
bible_quanes.answer: Yes; Jacob urged him, and he took it
bible_quanes.explanation: Jacob insisted that he take it.

bible_quanes.question: Where did Jacob build booths for his cattle?
bible_quanes.explanation: Succoth means 'booths'.

bible_quanes.question: Whom did Jacob place last in line?
bible_quanes.explanation: He placed those he valued most at the back.

bible_quanes.question: What did Esau first say about the gift?
bible_quanes.explanation: He initially refused it.

bible_quanes.question: To what did Jacob compare seeing Esau's face?
bible_quanes.answer: As though he had seen the face of God
bible_quanes.explanation: Esau had received him favorably.

bible_quanes.question: To which city in Canaan did Jacob come safely?
bible_quanes.explanation: He pitched his tent before the city.

bible_quanes.question: What did Jacob name the altar he built near Shechem?
bible_quanes.explanation: It means 'God, the God of Israel'.

bible_quanes.question: How much did Jacob pay for the land at Shechem?
bible_quanes.explanation: He bought it from the children of Hamor.

bible_quanes.question: Which daughter of Leah went out to see the daughters of the land?
bible_quanes.explanation: Dinah was Jacob's daughter.

bible_quanes.question: Who was the prince who violated Dinah?
bible_quanes.explanation: He was a Hivite.

bible_quanes.question: Which two brethren attacked the city?
bible_quanes.explanation: They were Dinah's full brethren.

bible_quanes.question: Who rebuked Simeon and Levi for their attack?
bible_quanes.explanation: He said they had made him obnoxious among the inhabitants.

bible_quanes.question: What did Hamor propose to Jacob's family?
bible_quanes.answer: Make marriages with us, and give your daughters unto us
bible_quanes.explanation: His son longed for Dinah.

bible_quanes.question: What condition did Jacob's sons set?
bible_quanes.answer: That every male of them be circumcised
bible_quanes.explanation: They spoke deceitfully.

bible_quanes.question: On which day after the circumcision did they attack?
bible_quanes.explanation: The men of the city were in pain.

bible_quanes.question: How did the brethren answer Jacob's rebuke?
bible_quanes.answer: "Should he deal with our sister as with an harlot?"
bible_quanes.explanation: They defended their action.

bible_quanes.question: What did the brethren take from the city?
bible_quanes.answer: All their wealth, their little ones and their wives, and all that was in the house
bible_quanes.explanation: They plundered every thing.

bible_quanes.question: Where did Hamor and Shechem speak to the men of their city?
bible_quanes.answer: At the gate of their city
bible_quanes.explanation: They tried to persuade them to agree.

bible_quanes.question: Where did God tell Jacob to go and build an altar?
bible_quanes.explanation: Where God had appeared to him when he fled from Esau.

bible_quanes.question: What name did God confirm for Jacob in Genesis 35?
bible_quanes.explanation: He would no longer be called Jacob.

bible_quanes.question: What did Jacob name Rachel's son born as she died?
bible_quanes.explanation: Rachel had named him Benoni.

bible_quanes.question: Where was Rachel buried?
bible_quanes.explanation: Jacob set a pillar on her grave.

bible_quanes.question: What did Jacob tell his household to put away?
bible_quanes.answer: The strange gods that were among them
bible_quanes.explanation: They were also to purify themselves.

bible_quanes.question: Where did Jacob hide the foreign gods?
bible_quanes.answer: Under the oak which was by Shechem
bible_quanes.explanation: He hid their earrings there too.

bible_quanes.question: Who was buried under the oak called Allonbachuth?
bible_quanes.explanation: The name means 'oak of weeping'.

bible_quanes.question: Who buried Isaac?
bible_quanes.explanation: Isaac died at 180 years old.

bible_quanes.question: Which son sinned with Bilhah, his father's concubine?
bible_quanes.explanation: Israel heard of it.

bible_quanes.question: By what name did God identify Himself in Genesis 35:11?
bible_quanes.explanation: He told Jacob to be fruitful and multiply.

bible_quanes.question: Genesis 36 lists the descendants of whom?
bible_quanes.explanation: Esau is identified with Edom.

bible_quanes.question: Where did Esau settle?
bible_quanes.explanation: He moved away from Jacob.

bible_quanes.question: Why did Esau move away from Jacob?
bible_quanes.answer: Their riches were more than that they might dwell together
bible_quanes.explanation: The land could not support them both.

bible_quanes.question: From where did Esau take his wives?
bible_quanes.explanation: Among them were Adah and Aholibamah.

bible_quanes.question: Who was Amalek's father?
bible_quanes.explanation: Amalek was born to Eliphaz's concubine Timna.

bible_quanes.question: What does Genesis 36:31 say about the kings of Edom?
bible_quanes.answer: These reigned in Edom before there reigned any king over Israel
bible_quanes.explanation: A list of Edom's kings follows.

bible_quanes.question: Who found water in the wilderness as he pastured his father's asses?
bible_quanes.explanation: Anah was the son of Zibeon.

bible_quanes.question: Who is called the father of the Edomites?
bible_quanes.explanation: The chapter closes with the chiefs of Edom.

bible_quanes.question: Who were the inhabitants of the land of Seir before Esau?
bible_quanes.answer: The sons of Seir the Horite
bible_quanes.explanation: They included Lotan, Shobal and Zibeon.

bible_quanes.question: Which son did Adah bear to Esau?
bible_quanes.explanation: Bashemath bore Reuel.

bible_quanes.question: Who was Jacob's favorite son?
bible_quanes.explanation: Jacob loved Joseph more than his other sons and gave him a colourful coat.

bible_quanes.question: How old was Joseph when he fed the flock with his brethren?
bible_quanes.explanation: He brought a bad report of them to his father.

bible_quanes.question: Why did Joseph's brethren hate him even more?
bible_quanes.explanation: They already envied him.

bible_quanes.question: Where did the brethren throw Joseph?
bible_quanes.explanation: There was no water in it.

bible_quanes.question: For how much was Joseph sold?
bible_quanes.explanation: He was sold to Ishmaelite/Midianite traders.

bible_quanes.question: What was Joseph's first dream about?
bible_quanes.answer: Your sheaves stood round about, and made obeisance to my sheaf
bible_quanes.explanation: They were binding sheaves in the field.

bible_quanes.question: What bowed to Joseph in his second dream?
bible_quanes.answer: The sun, the moon and eleven stars
bible_quanes.explanation: His father rebuked him for it.

bible_quanes.question: Which brother persuaded them not to kill Joseph?
bible_quanes.explanation: He planned to rescue him later.

bible_quanes.question: Who suggested selling Joseph?
bible_quanes.explanation: He asked what profit there was in killing him.

bible_quanes.question: How did the brethren deceive Jacob about Joseph?
bible_quanes.answer: They dipped Joseph's coat in a goat's blood
bible_quanes.explanation: Jacob assumed a wild beast had killed him.

bible_quanes.question: To whom was Joseph sold in Egypt?
bible_quanes.explanation: Potiphar was an officer of Pharaoh.

bible_quanes.question: Which brother left the others and visited Hirah the Adullamite?
bible_quanes.explanation: Judah married a Canaanite woman.

bible_quanes.question: Who was Er's wife?
bible_quanes.explanation: Judah chose her for his firstborn.

bible_quanes.question: Why did Er die?
bible_quanes.answer: He was wicked in the sight of the LORD
bible_quanes.explanation: The LORD took his life.

bible_quanes.question: Which of Tamar's twins broke through first?
bible_quanes.explanation: His name means 'breach'.

bible_quanes.question: What did Judah promise Tamar?
bible_quanes.answer: His son Shelah, when he was grown
bible_quanes.explanation: Judah did not keep the promise.

bible_quanes.question: What pledge did Judah give Tamar?
bible_quanes.answer: His signet, his bracelets and his staff
bible_quanes.explanation: She kept them as evidence.

bible_quanes.question: What did Judah confess about Tamar?
bible_quanes.answer: "She has been more righteous than I"
bible_quanes.explanation: He had withheld Shelah from her.

bible_quanes.question: What was tied on Zerah's hand?
bible_quanes.explanation: The midwife tied it to mark the firstborn.

bible_quanes.question: Why did Onan displease the LORD?
bible_quanes.answer: He spilled the seed on the ground, lest he should give seed to his brother
bible_quanes.explanation: The LORD took his life also.

bible_quanes.question: Where did Tamar sit, veiled, to wait for Judah?
bible_quanes.answer: In an open place by the way to Timnath, covered with a vail
bible_quanes.explanation: She saw that Shelah had not been given to her.

bible_quanes.question: Who bought Joseph in Egypt?
bible_quanes.explanation: He was captain of the guard.

bible_quanes.question: Why did Joseph prosper in Potiphar's house?
bible_quanes.explanation: He was a successful man.

bible_quanes.question: What did Joseph leave behind when he fled Potiphar's wife?
bible_quanes.explanation: She held onto it.

bible_quanes.question: Where was Joseph put after being falsely accused?
bible_quanes.explanation: The place where the king's prisoners were confined.

bible_quanes.question: What position did Potiphar give Joseph?
bible_quanes.explanation: He put all he had under Joseph's authority.

bible_quanes.question: What did Joseph say to Potiphar's wife?
bible_quanes.answer: "How can I do this great wickedness, and sin against God?"
bible_quanes.explanation: He refused her advances.

bible_quanes.question: How was Joseph described in Genesis 39:6?
bible_quanes.answer: A goodly person, and well favoured
bible_quanes.explanation: Potiphar's wife noticed him.

bible_quanes.question: What did the prison keeper give Joseph?
bible_quanes.answer: All the prisoners that were in the prison
bible_quanes.explanation: He trusted Joseph completely.

bible_quanes.question: For whose sake did the LORD bless Potiphar's house?
bible_quanes.explanation: The blessing was on all he had, in house and field.

bible_quanes.question: Why did the prison keeper not check any thing under Joseph's authority?
bible_quanes.answer: Because the LORD was with him and made that which he did to prosper
bible_quanes.explanation: He trusted him fully.

bible_quanes.question: Which two officials offended Pharaoh and were put in prison?
bible_quanes.answer: The chief butler and the chief baker
bible_quanes.explanation: They were put where Joseph was confined.

bible_quanes.question: What did the butler dream of?
bible_quanes.explanation: He pressed the grapes into Pharaoh's cup.

bible_quanes.question: What was on the baker's head in his dream?
bible_quanes.explanation: Birds ate from the top basket.

bible_quanes.question: Did the butler remember Joseph?
bible_quanes.explanation: Joseph remained in prison.

bible_quanes.question: What did Joseph say about interpreting dreams?
bible_quanes.explanation: He offered to interpret their dreams.

bible_quanes.question: What did Joseph say would happen to the butler within three days?
bible_quanes.answer: Pharaoh shall lift up his head and restore him unto his place
bible_quanes.explanation: He would again place Pharaoh's cup in his hand.

bible_quanes.question: What did Joseph say would happen to the baker?
bible_quanes.answer: Pharaoh shall hang him on a tree, and the birds shall eat his flesh
bible_quanes.explanation: This would happen within three days.

bible_quanes.question: What occasion fell on the third day?
bible_quanes.explanation: He made a feast for his servants.

bible_quanes.question: What did Joseph ask the butler to do?
bible_quanes.answer: Think on him, shew him kindness and make mention of him unto Pharaoh
bible_quanes.explanation: So that he could be released.

bible_quanes.question: How did Joseph describe how he came to Egypt?
bible_quanes.answer: He was stolen away out of the land of the Hebrews
bible_quanes.explanation: He had done nothing to deserve the dungeon.

bible_quanes.question: How long after the butler's release did Pharaoh have his dreams?
bible_quanes.explanation: Pharaoh dreamed by the river.

bible_quanes.question: What came up out of the river in Pharaoh's first dream?
bible_quanes.answer: Seven well favoured kine and fatfleshed, and seven other kine ill favoured and leanfleshed
bible_quanes.explanation: The thin cows ate the fat ones.

bible_quanes.question: What was Pharaoh's second dream about?
bible_quanes.answer: Seven ears of corn on one stalk, then seven thin ears blasted with the east wind
bible_quanes.explanation: The thin heads devoured the plump ones.

bible_quanes.question: How old was Joseph when he stood before Pharaoh?
bible_quanes.explanation: He went throughout all the land of Egypt.

bible_quanes.question: What did Joseph say Pharaoh's two dreams meant?
bible_quanes.answer: Seven years of plenty and seven years of famine
bible_quanes.explanation: God was showing Pharaoh what He was about to do.

bible_quanes.question: What did Pharaoh say about Joseph?
bible_quanes.answer: He was a man in whom is the Spirit of God
bible_quanes.explanation: No one was as discerning and wise.

bible_quanes.question: What did Pharaoh give Joseph?
bible_quanes.answer: His ring, vestures of fine linen and a gold chain
bible_quanes.explanation: These were signs of authority.

bible_quanes.question: Who became Joseph's wife?
bible_quanes.explanation: Her father was priest of On.

bible_quanes.question: What did Joseph name his firstborn, and why?
bible_quanes.answer: Manasseh: For God hath made him forget all his toil
bible_quanes.explanation: Manasseh sounds like 'making forget'.

bible_quanes.question: Why did Joseph name his second son Ephraim?
bible_quanes.answer: God had made him fruitful in the land of his affliction
bible_quanes.explanation: Ephraim sounds like 'fruitfulness'.

bible_quanes.question: Why did Jacob send his sons to Egypt?
bible_quanes.explanation: They went to buy food.

bible_quanes.question: Which son did Jacob keep at home?
bible_quanes.explanation: He feared some calamity might befall him.

bible_quanes.question: What did Joseph's brethren do when they came before him?
bible_quanes.answer: Bowed down with their faces to the earth
bible_quanes.explanation: This fulfilled Joseph's dreams.

bible_quanes.question: Which brother did Joseph bind and keep in Egypt?
bible_quanes.explanation: He was held as a hostage.

bible_quanes.question: What did Joseph accuse his brethren of being?
bible_quanes.explanation: He was testing them.

bible_quanes.question: Did the brethren recognize Joseph?
bible_quanes.explanation: But Joseph recognized them.

bible_quanes.question: What did the brethren say was the cause of their distress?
bible_quanes.answer: They were verily guilty concerning their brother Joseph
bible_quanes.explanation: They remembered his anguish when he pleaded with them.

bible_quanes.question: What did Joseph have put back into their sacks?
bible_quanes.explanation: When they found it, they were afraid.

bible_quanes.question: What did Jacob say would happen if harm came to Benjamin?
bible_quanes.answer: Ye shall bring down my gray hairs with sorrow to the grave
bible_quanes.explanation: He refused to let Benjamin go.

bible_quanes.question: What did Reuben offer as a guarantee for Benjamin?
bible_quanes.answer: Slay my two sons, if I bring him not to thee
bible_quanes.explanation: Jacob still refused.

bible_quanes.question: Who offered himself as surety for Benjamin?
bible_quanes.explanation: He would bear the blame for ever if Benjamin did not return.

bible_quanes.question: What did Joseph do when he saw Benjamin with his brothers?
bible_quanes.answer: Bring these men home, and slay, and make ready; for these men shall dine with me at noon
bible_quanes.explanation: They were to dine with him.

bible_quanes.question: Why did Joseph hurry to his chamber?
bible_quanes.explanation: His heart yearned for his brother Benjamin.

bible_quanes.question: How much more food did Benjamin receive than his brothers?
bible_quanes.explanation: The brothers feasted with Joseph.

bible_quanes.question: What did Jacob send as a present to the ruler of Egypt?
bible_quanes.answer: A little balm, a little honey, spices, myrrh, nuts and almonds
bible_quanes.explanation: The best fruits of the land.

bible_quanes.question: How much money did Jacob tell his sons to take?
bible_quanes.explanation: Including the money returned in their sacks.

bible_quanes.question: What did the steward say about the money in their sacks?
bible_quanes.answer: God hath given you treasure in your sacks: I had your money
bible_quanes.explanation: Then he brought Simeon out to them.

bible_quanes.question: Why were the brothers astonished at the table?
bible_quanes.answer: They sat the firstborn according to his birthright, and the youngest according to his youth
bible_quanes.explanation: From the firstborn to the youngest.

bible_quanes.question: Why did the Egyptians eat separately from the Hebrews?
bible_quanes.answer: It was an abomination to the Egyptians to eat with Hebrews
bible_quanes.explanation: Joseph ate separately as well.

bible_quanes.question: By what name did Jacob call on God as he sent his sons back?
bible_quanes.explanation: He asked that God would give them mercy before the man.

bible_quanes.question: What did Joseph have put in Benjamin's sack?
bible_quanes.explanation: Along with Benjamin's grain money.

bible_quanes.question: In whose sack was the cup found?
bible_quanes.explanation: The steward searched from the oldest to the youngest.

bible_quanes.question: How did the brethren react when the cup was found?
bible_quanes.explanation: They all returned to the city.

bible_quanes.question: What did Judah offer to do?
bible_quanes.answer: Abide as a bondman instead of the lad
bible_quanes.explanation: He pleaded for Benjamin to go home.

bible_quanes.question: What did the steward say the cup was used for?
bible_quanes.explanation: He called it the cup his master drank from.

bible_quanes.question: What did the brethren rashly promise if the cup was found with one of them?
bible_quanes.answer: Let him die, and we also will be my lord's bondmen
bible_quanes.explanation: They were sure of their innocence.

bible_quanes.question: What did Judah say God had found out?
bible_quanes.explanation: It was a confession of their guilt.

bible_quanes.question: Why could Judah not return home without Benjamin?
bible_quanes.answer: Lest he see the evil that shall come on his father
bible_quanes.explanation: He was concerned for Jacob.

bible_quanes.question: How did Judah describe Jacob's attachment to Benjamin?
bible_quanes.answer: His life is bound up in the lad's life
bible_quanes.explanation: Jacob would die if Benjamin was lost.

bible_quanes.question: What did Judah say about Benjamin's brother (Joseph), not knowing he was speaking to him?
bible_quanes.answer: His brother was dead, and he alone was left of his mother
bible_quanes.explanation: He was unknowingly describing Joseph to Joseph.

bible_quanes.question: What did Joseph say when he revealed himself?
bible_quanes.answer: "I am Joseph; doth my father yet live?"
bible_quanes.explanation: His brethren were dismayed and could not answer.

bible_quanes.question: Why did Joseph say God had sent him to Egypt?
bible_quanes.explanation: He told his brethren not to be grieved or angry with themselves.

bible_quanes.question: In which land would Jacob's family live?
bible_quanes.explanation: They would be near Joseph.

bible_quanes.question: What did Jacob say after hearing Joseph was alive?
bible_quanes.answer: "I will go and see him before I die"
bible_quanes.explanation: His spirit revived.

bible_quanes.question: How many more years of famine remained when Joseph revealed himself?
bible_quanes.explanation: Two years of famine had already passed.

bible_quanes.question: What did Joseph say God had made him?
bible_quanes.answer: A father to Pharaoh, lord of his house and ruler over all Egypt
bible_quanes.explanation: He saw God's hand in his story.

bible_quanes.question: What did Benjamin receive from Joseph?
bible_quanes.answer: Three hundred pieces of silver and five changes of raiment
bible_quanes.explanation: More than his brethren.

bible_quanes.question: What did Joseph tell his brethren as they left?
bible_quanes.answer: "See that ye fall not out by the way"
bible_quanes.explanation: He urged them not to quarrel.

bible_quanes.question: What finally revived Jacob's spirit?
bible_quanes.answer: When he saw the wagons which Joseph had sent to carry him
bible_quanes.explanation: They were proof Joseph was alive.

bible_quanes.question: How did Jacob first react to the news?
bible_quanes.answer: His heart fainted, for he believed them not
bible_quanes.explanation: The news seemed too good to be true.

bible_quanes.question: Where did Israel offer sacrifices on the way to Egypt?
bible_quanes.explanation: He offered them to the God of his father Isaac.

bible_quanes.question: What did God tell Jacob about going down to Egypt?
bible_quanes.answer: Do not fear; I will make you a great nation there
bible_quanes.explanation: God promised to go with him.

bible_quanes.question: Where did Joseph meet his father?
bible_quanes.explanation: Joseph fell on his neck and wept a long while.

bible_quanes.question: What did Israel say to Joseph when they met?
bible_quanes.answer: "Now let me die, since I have seen your face"
bible_quanes.explanation: His joy was complete.

bible_quanes.question: How many of Jacob's house came into Egypt in total?
bible_quanes.explanation: This includes Joseph and his two sons.

bible_quanes.question: How many came with Jacob, not counting his sons' wives?
bible_quanes.explanation: These were his direct descendants.

bible_quanes.question: Why did Joseph tell his family to say they were shepherds?
bible_quanes.answer: That ye may dwell in Goshen; for every shepherd is an abomination unto the Egyptians
bible_quanes.explanation: It kept the family together and separate.

bible_quanes.question: What did God promise about Joseph in Jacob's vision?
bible_quanes.answer: Joseph shall put his hand upon thine eyes
bible_quanes.explanation: Jacob would die with Joseph beside him.

bible_quanes.question: Whom did Jacob send ahead to Joseph?
bible_quanes.explanation: To point out the way to Goshen.

bible_quanes.question: Which sons were born to Joseph in Egypt?
bible_quanes.explanation: Their mother was Asenath.

bible_quanes.question: What did Jacob do when he met Pharaoh?
bible_quanes.explanation: Joseph presented his father before Pharaoh.

bible_quanes.question: How old did Jacob say he was when he met Pharaoh?
bible_quanes.explanation: He said his years had been few and evil.

bible_quanes.question: What land did Joseph give his family?
bible_quanes.answer: The land of Rameses, in the best of the land
bible_quanes.explanation: As Pharaoh had commanded.

bible_quanes.question: Where did Jacob ask to be buried?
bible_quanes.answer: Not in Egypt, but with his fathers
bible_quanes.explanation: Joseph swore to do it.

bible_quanes.question: What did Joseph collect in exchange for grain at first?
bible_quanes.answer: All the money in Egypt and Canaan
bible_quanes.explanation: He brought it into Pharaoh's house.

bible_quanes.question: What did Joseph take in exchange for food after the money ran out?
bible_quanes.answer: Their cattle, horses, flocks and asses
bible_quanes.explanation: He gave them bread for their horses, flocks and herds.

bible_quanes.question: What did Joseph buy for Pharaoh during the famine?
bible_quanes.explanation: Except the priests' land.

bible_quanes.question: What portion of the harvest was given to Pharaoh?
bible_quanes.explanation: The other four-fifths were for the people.

bible_quanes.question: Whose land did Joseph not buy?
bible_quanes.explanation: They received rations from Pharaoh.

bible_quanes.question: How long did Jacob live in Egypt?
bible_quanes.explanation: He died at 147 years old.

bible_quanes.question: Which two sons did Joseph bring to his sick father?
bible_quanes.explanation: Jacob blessed them.

bible_quanes.question: On whose head did Jacob put his right hand?
bible_quanes.explanation: Even though Ephraim was the younger.

bible_quanes.question: Why could Jacob scarcely see Joseph's sons?
bible_quanes.answer: His eyes were dim with age
bible_quanes.explanation: He kissed and embraced them.

bible_quanes.question: Whom did Jacob set before Manasseh?
